_comment: Add a person = one entry. group: 'lab' (runs Kuro Labs) or 'creators'. photo: optional path under /assets/img/ (omit for a monogram). video/links optional.

members.name: Kuro
members.bio: Founded Kuro Labs. Builds the software, games and this site, makes VRChat assets, and handles the listings, storefronts and promotion for the lab and the creators it works with.

members.name: Galvandus
members.bio: Galvandus makes interactive avatar props for VRChat, from a wearable bottle that casts light to one that reacts to music in AudioLink worlds. His first two releases with Kuro Labs are Bottle of Light and Bottle of Party Essence.
